zh.summary: 把「完成收件檢查」拆成目標、動作、判斷與回復路徑，找出介面必須支援的工作。
objectives: 為操作任務定義起訖、前置條件與成功結果。
區分人的動作、資訊需求、系統回饋與例外。
用任務走讀找出草圖與流程的缺口。

readingGuide.goal: 為操作任務定義起訖、前置條件與成功結果。
readingGuide.startingPoint: problem.md、文字編輯器、缺件與修改兩張合成事件卡；不需安裝分析工具。
readingGuide.route: 先看情境與原理，再比較例子，最後擴寫 wireframe-notes.md 並用檢核題自查。
readingGuide.output: wireframe-notes.md 具有任務拆解表、條件及一項待確認資訊，能接回 problem.md。

sections.heading: 先寫目標，暫時不列元件
paragraphs: Task Analysis（任務分析）研究使用者為達成目標需要做什麼，以及各工作之間的順序、條件與負擔。本課接續 M03 的 User Flow，把「補齊後匯出」再拆細，找出每一步需要的資訊、判斷及回饋。
「一個輸入框、兩個按鈕、一張表」是元件清單；「發現缺漏、找到資料來源、補上、重新檢查、確認報告」才在描述工作。先理解工作，才能知道哪些元件有必要。

sections.heading: 像拆解如何完成一道料理
paragraphs: 食譜的目標是完成可食用的餐點，不是碰過鍋子、盤子和瓦斯爐。洗菜、判斷熟度與處理缺少食材各有條件；如果只記錄用了哪些器具，就無法教下一位如何完成。
表單也有看不見的判斷：使用者如何知道文件類型、怎麼確認已補齊、為什麼修改後需重查。這些不一定對應一次點擊，卻可能決定任務能否完成。

sections.heading: 在每一步加上所需資訊與出口
paragraphs: 下面是合成任務分析，沒有假裝已觀察實際收件人員。前置條件為取得三欄合成資料及本課規則；起點是開始處理這筆資料，終點是取得與目前輸入一致的完整性報告，或明確取消。
每列都要問「人此時需要知道什麼」。如果文件類型根本無法取得，就不應由模型猜一個值讓流程通過；需要回到 M03 確認補件責任，或暫停這筆任務。

blocks.caption: 表 1｜從目標拆到可設計的工作
rows: 準備資料
理解本課三欄定義並取得合成值
說明必填與範例；資料未知時保留缺件
輸入並檢查
輸入資料，啟動目前資料的檢查
標籤持續可見，顯示檢查結果
修正缺漏
找到缺少欄位，取得值後補填
保留已填資料；缺件不能完整匯出
確認結果
核對預覽是否為目前資料
修改後使舊結果失效，重新檢查
完成或退出
取得當次報告，或取消本次任務
清楚表示結果與限制；取消與失敗不是完成

sections.heading: 拆解層次與執行順序要分開
paragraphs: 階層式拆解回答「這個目標包含哪些子任務」；執行計畫回答「何時做哪些子任務」。例如「處理缺件」可以包括辨識欄位、取得資料及補填，但只有缺件時才需要走這條支線。不能因為列在第三項，就要求每個人都先遇到錯誤。
NN/G 的任務分析文章將資料蒐集與分析分開，也說明子任務的順序、層次與條件。本課圖只呈現一次走讀的分析順序，不冒稱完整 HTA（階層式任務分析）圖或通用任務模型。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜分析一項操作的走讀順序
blocks.description: 這是分析者依序提問的路線，不代表使用者每次操作都必經缺件。

items.title: 目標與情境
items.body: 誰在何時，需要得到什麼結果？先固定起點與終點。

items.title: 動作與判斷
items.body: 要輸入、尋找、比較或決定什麼？每步需要哪些資訊？

items.title: 條件與回復
items.body: 缺件、修改、取消時，如何保留進度並回到正確位置？

items.title: 介面與證據
items.body: 把必要回饋標到草圖，規劃如何確認人能完成工作。

sections.heading: 看操作負擔，也看思考負擔
paragraphs: 如果使用者必須先記住錯誤清單，再捲回上方找欄位，負擔不只是捲動次數，還包括記住哪欄缺漏。讓提示靠近欄位並保留整體結果，可能降低來回核對的需要，但效果仍需用任務試用確認。
NN/G 建議不能只依自述或模擬推定真實工作，還應理解實際使用情境。本課的紙上走讀只找明顯缺口；正式分析若要量化時間、頻率或認知負擔，需另外蒐集合適證據，不能填入猜測秒數當作量測。

sections.heading: 用事件卡檢查下一步是否完整
paragraphs: 請同儕先拿缺文件類型的合成資料，再依草圖指出如何補回與重新檢查。接著給他「已完成檢查後又修改」的事件卡，問哪些結果需要失效。記錄是缺資訊、找不到動作，還是業務規則未明。
常見誤解是把分析變成逐個元件點選。若任務無法取得必要資料，單純把按鈕放大並不能解決。把觀察到的阻礙接回 problem.md，將介面候選留在 wireframe-notes.md，再交由下一篇安排資訊。

blocks.heading: 任務分析工作表
paragraphs: 將以下合成範例放入 wireframe-notes.md，依你的課堂情境修改；這不是實際單位規定或研究結果。
blocks.code:
# 任務分析（合成）
目標：修正缺件並取得當次完整性報告
前置：有合成資料及本課欄位規則
起點：開始處理這筆資料
終點：下載當次報告，或明確取消
子任務：辨識缺漏 → 取得資料 → 補填 → 重查 → 核對與匯出
條件：無缺件可略過補件；修改後必須重新檢查
資訊缺口：文件類型從何取得？待確認
介面候選：欄位旁提示、保留已填值、過期結果失效
證據：紙上走讀紀錄；不等於真實工作時間量測

exercise.environment: problem.md、文字編輯器、缺件與修改兩張合成事件卡；不需安裝分析工具。
steps: 寫出任務目標、前置條件、起訖及完成結果，避免先列按鈕。
將修正與匯出拆為子任務，各寫人的判斷、需要資訊、系統回饋與例外。
依兩張事件卡走讀，標記一處資訊缺口及介面候選；單人可輪流扮演操作者與觀察者核對。
exercise.expected: wireframe-notes.md 具有任務拆解表、條件及一項待確認資訊，能接回 problem.md。
exercise.check: 能解釋每步為何存在；缺件、修改及取消有出口，沒有把點擊數當成全部工作量。
exercise.cleanup: 保留合成與紙上演練標記；沒有實際觀察或計時就保持未測量。

en.summary: Break “complete the intake check” into goals, actions, judgments and recovery paths to identify the work the interface must support.
objectives: Define task boundaries, preconditions and a successful outcome.
Distinguish human actions, information needs, system feedback and exceptions.
Use a task walkthrough to find gaps in sketches and flows.

readingGuide.goal: Define task boundaries, preconditions and a successful outcome.
readingGuide.startingPoint: problem.md, a text editor and two synthetic event cards for missing information and edits; no analysis tool installation is needed.
readingGuide.route: Read the situation and principles, compare examples, then expand wireframe-notes.md and use the checks to review your understanding.
readingGuide.output: A task-decomposition table, conditions and one pending information question in wireframe-notes.md, connected to problem.md.

sections.heading: Define the Goal Before Listing Components
paragraphs: Task analysis studies what users need to do to achieve goals, including order, conditions and effort. Building on M03 User Flow, break “correct and export” into smaller actions to identify each step’s information, judgments and feedback.

“One input, two buttons and a table” lists components. “Find the omission, locate the information, fill it in, recheck and confirm the report” describes work. Understanding that work helps determine which components are needed.

sections.heading: Analyze How to Complete a Dish
paragraphs: A recipe aims at an edible meal, not merely touching a pot, plate and stove. Washing ingredients, judging doneness and handling unavailable ingredients have conditions. Recording utensils alone cannot teach the next person to cook.

Forms also involve less visible judgments: how users find document type, recognize completion and understand rechecking after edits. These need not correspond to individual clicks, yet can determine completion.

sections.heading: Add Information Needs and Exits to Every Step
paragraphs: This is synthetic task analysis, not observation of actual intake staff. Preconditions are three synthetic fields and the course rules. The task starts with processing that record and ends with a completeness report matching current input, or explicit cancellation.

For every row, ask what the person needs to know. If document type cannot be obtained, do not have a model guess a value to pass the flow. Return to M03 to clarify correction responsibility or pause that record’s task.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | From a Goal to Work You Can Design For
rows: Prepare data
Understand the three course fields and obtain synthetic values.
Explain requirements and examples; retain missing status for unknown data.
Enter and check
Enter data and start checking current input.
Keep labels identifiable and show results.
Correct omissions
Locate the missing field and fill it after obtaining the value.
Retain entered values; missing input cannot export as complete.
Confirm results
Check that the preview matches current data.
Edits invalidate old results and require rechecking.
Finish or exit
Obtain the current report or cancel this task.
State results and limits; cancellation and failure are not completion.

sections.heading: Separate Decomposition from Execution Order
paragraphs: Hierarchical decomposition asks which subtasks belong to a goal; an execution plan asks when to perform them. Missing-information handling may include locating the field, obtaining data and filling it in, but applies only when data is missing. Third position in a list does not require every user to encounter an error.

NN/G separates data collection from analysis and discusses subtask order, levels and conditions. The course diagram shows an analyst’s walkthrough sequence, not a complete Hierarchical Task Analysis (HTA) diagram or universal task model.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | A Walkthrough Sequence for Analyzing an Action
blocks.description: This is the analyst’s questioning sequence, not a requirement that users encounter missing information on every attempt.

items.title: Goal and context
items.body: Who needs which result, and when? Fix the start and endpoint.

items.title: Actions and judgments
items.body: What must they enter, find, compare or decide? What information does each step need?

items.title: Conditions and recovery
items.body: For omissions, edits or cancellation, how is progress retained and the correct point regained?

items.title: Interface and evidence
items.body: Annotate necessary feedback on the sketch and plan how to check task completion.

sections.heading: Consider Mental Effort Alongside Physical Actions
paragraphs: If users must memorize errors and scroll upward to locate fields, the burden includes remembering omissions, not just scrolling. Nearby field feedback plus an overall result may reduce repeated comparisons, but task testing must establish the effect.

NN/G recommends understanding actual work context rather than relying solely on reported behavior or simulations. This tabletop walkthrough finds obvious gaps only. Quantifying time, frequency or cognitive effort requires additional suitable evidence; guessed seconds are not measurements.

sections.heading: Check Next Steps with Event Cards
paragraphs: Give a peer synthetic input missing document type and ask them to identify correction and rechecking on the sketch. Then give the “edit after checking” card and ask which results become invalid. Record whether information, discoverable actions or clear business rules are missing.

A common mistake is reducing analysis to clicking components. Enlarging a button cannot obtain unavailable data. Bring identified barriers back to problem.md and keep interface candidates in wireframe-notes.md for the next lesson’s information arrangement.

blocks.heading: Task Analysis Worksheet
paragraphs: The original Traditional Chinese template records the correction/report goal, synthetic-data preconditions, start and endpoint, subtasks, conditional correction/rechecking, the document-type information gap, candidate feedback and tabletop evidence limits. Adapt it for class; it is not actual rules or findings.

條件：無缺件可略過補件；修改後必須重新檢查

exercise.environment: problem.md, a text editor and two synthetic event cards for missing information and edits; no analysis tool installation is needed.
steps: Write the task goal, preconditions, start, endpoint and outcome before listing buttons.
Decompose correction and export, recording judgments, information, feedback and exceptions for each subtask.
Walk through both cards, marking one information gap and an interface candidate. Independent learners can alternate operator and observer perspectives.
exercise.expected: A task-decomposition table, conditions and one pending information question in wireframe-notes.md, connected to problem.md.
exercise.check: Explain why each step exists. Omissions, edits and cancellation have exits; click counts do not represent all work.
exercise.cleanup: Retain synthetic/tabletop labels. Keep unobserved or untimed items unmeasured.

zh.prompt: 哪一項最適合當任務分析的起點？
options: 先決定用三張卡片
收件者要修正缺漏並取得對應目前資料的報告
先估一個完成秒數
把所有按鈕列出
rationales: 版型選擇應服務任務。
這有角色、工作目標與結果，可再定義起訖。
未測量不能當成現況。
元件清單不能直接說明工作目的。

en.prompt: What is a suitable starting point for task analysis?
options: Choose three cards first.
An intake worker needs to correct omissions and obtain a report matching current data.
Guess a completion time in seconds.
List every button.
rationales: Layout should serve the task.
This identifies a role, work goal and outcome whose boundaries can be defined.
An unmeasured estimate is not observed current work.
A component list cannot directly explain purpose.

zh.prompt: 缺件子任務列在第三項，代表什麼？
options: 每次操作都必須先製造缺件
每個人都要依項目數量點三次
只有觸發缺件條件才走該支線，還需交代補齊後回到哪裡
缺件完全不用設計
rationales: 子任務清單不是所有人必經的線性流程。
清單數量不能轉成點擊要求。
層次、順序與條件要一起記錄。
核心失敗情境仍需回復路徑。

en.prompt: The missing-information subtask is third in a list. What follows?
options: Every attempt must first create missing input.
Each person must click three times.
Take that branch only when its condition holds, also specifying where completion returns.
Missing information needs no design.
rationales: A subtask list is not an unavoidable linear path.
List length does not specify click requirements.
Record hierarchy, order and conditions together.
A core failure situation still needs recovery.

zh.prompt: 紙上走讀找不到缺口，可推論什麼？
options: 已觀察的合成路徑暫無明顯缺口，實作與真人情境仍待驗
所有人的完成時間都已改善
所有認知負擔都已量化
正式系統已可上線
rationales: 結論限於該次方法與範圍。
沒有真人與時間證據。
沒有蒐集足以量化的資料。
走讀不驗證實作、安全與維運。

en.prompt: A tabletop walkthrough finds no gap. What can be inferred?
options: No obvious gap was found in those synthetic paths; implementation and actual user contexts remain to be verified.
Everyone’s completion time improved.
All cognitive effort was quantified.
The production system can launch.
rationales: The conclusion is limited to that method and scope.
There is no actual participant or timing evidence.
No data sufficient for quantification was collected.
A walkthrough does not verify implementation, security or operations.
